issuer: the New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission (MVC)
note: The MVC's license and permit fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives the auto licence at $24 initial and $24 renewal, and a student learner's permit from 16; the first-licence page has a new driver practise supervised for 6 months, take a probationary licence, drive unsupervised for a year and then upgrade to a basic licence, so a basic (full) licence is kept from 18 (16 plus the steps, rounded up to a whole year). The non-driver ID page gives the card to residents 14 and older for $24. Neither page states how many years a licence or card lasts, so both terms are null (the MVC's statute, N.J.S.A. 39:3-10, wasn't reached).
